INSERT INTO t_user_active_day(stat_date,user_id,farm_id,op_count,record_count,created_at,updated_at) SELECT stat_date,user_id,farm_id,MAX(ops),0,NOW(),NOW() FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) stat_date,user_id,0 farm_id,COUNT(*) ops FROM t_login_log WHERE result='SUCCESS' AND user_id > 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end},INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at),user_id UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at),operator_id,COALESCE(farm_id,0),COUNT(*) FROM t_operation_log WHERE operator_type='USER' AND result='SUCCESS' AND operator_id > 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end},INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at),operator_id,COALESCE(farm_id,0) ) logs GROUP BY stat_date,user_id,farm_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE op_count=GREATEST(op_count,VALUES(op_count)),updated_at=NOW()

INSERT INTO t_platform_daily_stat(stat_date,active_user_count,new_user_count, production_record_count,active_farm_count,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{date},COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN op_count > 0 THEN user_id END), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{date},INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status <> 'CANCELLED'), COALESCE(SUM(record_count),0), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN record_count > 0 AND farm_id > 0 THEN farm_id END),NOW(),NOW() FROM t_user_active_day WHERE stat_date=#{date} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active_user_count=VALUES(active_user_count),new_user_count=VALUES(new_user_count), production_record_count=VALUES(production_record_count),active_farm_count=VALUES(active_farm_count),updated_at=NOW()
